sources.snippet: AWS released Strands Decider 2B, an open-source 2B-parameter AI model that picks agent actions in under 100ms. Here's what it means for AI agents.

sources.title: AWS releases Strands Decider 2B, an open-source AI agent decision model
sources.snippet: AWS released Strands Decider 2B on October 1, 2026, a 2-billion-parameter open-source model designed to make fast, local routing and policy decisions for AI agents without generating text.
